description:
Create a web request returning an SQF promise, allowing communication with web servers in game.
{{Feature|informative|See {{Link|Arma 3: WebAPI|WebAPI}} for a full tutorial.}}
examples:
<sqf>
spawn {
	private _handle = webRequest #{
		"type": "http",
		//"method": "GET", "GET" is default
		"origin": "test",
		"url": "https://myip.wtf/text"
	};
	private _result = waitUntil _handle; // suspend until it is ready
	_result params ["_request", "_result"];
	systemChat format ["My IP is: %1", _result get "body"];
};
</sqf>
name: webRequest
